basis.label: Fire Detection and Alarm System ITM Tasks, frequency "20 Years and As Part of Other Building Inspection (not part of ITM requirements)": "Smoke Detectors not monitored internally or by the control panel for sensitivity or obscuration as appropriate, (single-station detectors, and system detectors)" - "Replace detectors."
basis.note: Printed page 25. System (and single-station) smoke detectors whose sensitivity is not monitored by the device or panel. Smoke detectors only; heat detectors have no replacement interval in the table (restorable heat detectors are tested every 2 years). Detectors whose sensitivity is monitored have no fixed replacement interval here.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
